Name: SkinType
What it means in plain language: Oily, Dry, Normal, Combination

Name: Sensitivity
What it means in plain language: Sensitive or not

Name: SkinConcern
What it means in plain language: Acne, dryness, redness, hyperpigmentation, wrinkles, dullness, pores, oiliness
Where it comes from: Mine, to be ALIGNED TO DermO

Name: Benefit
What it means in plain language: Hydrating, brightening, soothing. These are labels people use, not logical classes, so SKOS not OWL

Name: IngredientFunction
What it means in plain language: Emollient, humectant, preservative, UV filter, surfactant, antioxidant, solvent, viscosity controller, skin conditioning, fragrance, chelating agent
Where it comes from: Names taken from CosIng; aligned to OntoCosmetic

Name: RegulatoryStatus
What it means in plain language: Prohibited (Annex II), Restricted (III), Permitted colorant (IV), preservative (V), UV filter (VI), Declarable allergen (the EU 26)

Name: Annex
What it means in plain language: AnnexII to AnnexVI. These are specific entries, not kinds of thing, so individuals not classes

Name: Authority
What it means in plain language: European Commission, SCCS, and later the Lebanese Ministry of Health. A status is always granted BY somebody

Name: Product
What it means in plain language: The thing on the shelf. Subclasses: Cleanser, Moisturiser (with SunCare under it), Serum, Toner, Exfoliant (chemical and physical), Mask, EyeCare, Treatment

Name: Ingredient
What it means in plain language: One individual per CosIng entry, identified by its register ID not by its name

Name: IngredientListing
What it means in plain language: REIFIED. An ingredient AT A POSITION in one product's list. Needed because INCI order is concentration order, and a plain triple has no room for the position

Name: Brand
What it means in plain language: The maker

Name: Offer
What it means in plain language: A price, from one shop, on one date. SEPARATE from the product, which is why one lotion can carry two Beirut prices

Name: Shop
What it means in plain language: Online or physical

Name: Country
What it means in plain language: Where a brand or shop is

Name: Claim
What it means in plain language: REIFIED. A statement about a product, carrying who said it, where, when, the exact sentence, and how much that source is worth. THIS IS THE CONTRIBUTION

Name: EvidenceLevel
What it means in plain language: ManufacturerStated (1), RetailerStated (2), WeakSourceStated (3), FormulaInferred (4)

Name: prov:Agent
What it means in plain language: Manufacturer, Retailer, InferenceProcedure. Whoever made the claim

Name: LebaneseShop
What it means in plain language: A shop that actually sells here

Name: ConsumerNeed
What it means in plain language: A need as an entity in its own right, not an attribute. Budget-constrained routine, single-shop routine, humid-season routine, occasion routine

Name: skc:hasListing
What it means in plain language: Links a product to one positioned ingredient entry

Name: skc:listsIngredient
What it means in plain language: Which ingredient that entry refers to

Name: skc:hasIngredient
What it means in plain language: Shortcut from product straight to ingredient, so simple queries stay simple

Name: skc:hasFunction
What it means in plain language: What an ingredient does

Name: skc:restrictedUnder
What it means in plain language: Which annex restricts this ingredient

Name: skc:accordingTo
What it means in plain language: WHICH AUTHORITY says so. Leaves room for Lebanese regulation later

Name: skc:suitableFor
What it means in plain language: Product suits a skin type

Name: skc:addressesConcern
What it means in plain language: Product addresses a concern

Name: skc:notRecommendedFor
What it means in plain language: Product should be avoided for a skin type

Name: schema:offers
What it means in plain language: Product to Offer

Name: schema:seller
What it means in plain language: Offer to Shop. NOTE the price lives on the Offer, not the Product

Name: skc:hasClaim
What it means in plain language: Product to Claim

Name: skc:hasEvidenceLevel
What it means in plain language: Claim to its level

Name: prov:wasAttributedTo
What it means in plain language: Who said it

Name: prov:wasDerivedFrom
What it means in plain language: The page it was read from

Name: skc:satisfiedBy
What it means in plain language: A need is satisfied by a product or a set of them

Name: skc:atPosition
What it means in plain language: Where in the INCI list. Concentration order

Name: skc:cosingCoverage
What it means in plain language: What share of the formula was found in the register

Name: skc:ingredientCount
What it means in plain language: How many ingredients

Name: schema:price
What it means in plain language: On the Offer

Name: skc:priceSeenDate
What it means in plain language: When that price was true

Name: SensitiveSafeProduct
What it means in plain language: Any product NONE of whose ingredients is a declarable allergen. I never list them; the reasoner works it out. Expect about 9,537

Name: AvailableInLebanon
What it means in plain language: Any product with at least one Offer from a Lebanese shop. Expect about 11,937

Name: ManufacturerStatedProduct
What it means in plain language: Any product whose suitability claim is level 1. Expect about 4,460

Name: RegulatedProduct
What it means in plain language: Contains at least one restricted ingredient. Expect about 9,613

Name: FullyIdentifiedProduct
What it means in plain language: Every ingredient found in the register. Expect about 9,032

Name: NaturalClaimProduct
What it means in plain language: Marketed as natural. Built to TEST against Klaschka's finding that 56% of natural INCI substances are classified hazardous
